name: select
title: Select
description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from, triggered by a button.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SelectRootEmits, SelectRootProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { SelectRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<SelectRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<SelectRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <SelectRoot
    data-slot="select"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot />
  </SelectRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import {
  SelectContent,
  type SelectContentEmits,
  type SelectContentProps,
  SelectPortal,
  SelectViewport,

  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from 'reka-ui';
import { SelectScrollDownButton, SelectScrollUpButton } from '.';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<SelectContentProps>(),
  {
    position: 'popper',
  },
);
const emits = defineEmits<SelectContentEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <SelectPortal>
    <SelectContent
      data-slot="select-content"
      v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
      class="sigma-ui-select-content"
      :class="[$attrs.class]"
    >
      <SelectScrollUpButton />
      <SelectViewport
        class="sigma-ui-select-content__viewport"
        :class="{ 'sigma-ui-select-content__viewport--popper': position === 'popper' }"
      >
        <slot />
      </SelectViewport>
      <SelectScrollDownButton />
    </SelectContent>
  </SelectPortal>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-select-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 50;
    overflow: hidden auto;
    min-width: calc(var(--spacing) * 32);
    max-height: var(--reka-select-content-available-height, 24rem);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    backdrop-filter: blur(var(--backdrop-filter-blur));
    background-color: var(--popover);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);
    color: var(--popover-foreground);
    transform-origin: var(--reka-popover-content-transform-origin);
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-content[data-state="open"][data-side="bottom"] {
    animation: sigma-ui-select-slide-from-top 150ms ease-out;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-content[data-state="open"][data-side="top"] {
    animation: sigma-ui-select-slide-from-bottom 150ms ease-out;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-content[data-state="open"][data-side="left"] {
    animation: sigma-ui-select-slide-from-right 150ms ease-out;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-content[data-state="open"][data-side="right"] {
    animation: sigma-ui-select-slide-from-left 150ms ease-out;
  }

  @keyframes sigma-ui-select-slide-from-top {
    from {
      filter: blur(4px);
      transform: translateY(-1rem) scaleY(0.98);
    }

    to {
      filter: blur(0);
      transform: translateY(0) scaleY(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes sigma-ui-select-slide-from-bottom {
    from {
      filter: blur(4px);
      transform: translateY(1rem) scaleY(0.98);
    }

    to {
      filter: blur(0);
      transform: translateY(0) scaleY(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes sigma-ui-select-slide-from-left {
    from {
      filter: blur(4px);
      transform: translateX(-1rem) scaleY(0.98);
    }

    to {
      filter: blur(0);
      transform: translateX(0) scaleY(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes sigma-ui-select-slide-from-right {
    from {
      filter: blur(4px);
      transform: translateX(1rem) scaleY(0.98);
    }

    to {
      filter: blur(0);
      transform: translateX(0) scaleY(1);
    }
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-content__viewport {
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
    scroll-margin-block: 0.25rem;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-content__viewport--popper {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: var(--reka-select-trigger-width);
    height: var(--reka-select-trigger-height);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { SelectGroup, type SelectGroupProps } from 'reka-ui';

  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<SelectGroupProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SelectGroup
    class="sigma-ui-select-group"
    data-slot="select-group"
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </SelectGroup>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-select-group {
    width: 100%;
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectItemText, type SelectItemTextProps } from 'reka-ui';

<template>

@layer base, components;

    :class="[$attrs.class]"

<style>
@layer base, components;

  .sigma-ui-select-scroll-down {

    justify-content: center;
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1) 0;

  .sigma-ui-select-scroll-down__icon {

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-select-separator {
    height: 1px;
    margin: calc(var(--spacing) * 1) calc(var(--spacing) * -1);
    background-color: var(--border);
    pointer-events: none;

}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { SelectIcon, SelectTrigger, type SelectTriggerProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core';
import { ChevronDownIcon } from '@lucide/vue';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

interface SelectTriggerExtraProps extends SelectTriggerProps {
  /**
   * Height of the trigger. `sm` matches the small button.
   */
  size?: 'sm' | 'default';
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectTriggerExtraProps>(), {
  size: 'default',
});

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(reactiveOmit(props, 'size'));
</script>

<template>
  <SelectTrigger
    data-slot="select-trigger"
    v-bind="{ ...forwardedProps, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :data-size="props.size"
    class="sigma-ui-select-trigger"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
    <SelectIcon as-child>
      <ChevronDownIcon class="sigma-ui-select-trigger__icon" />
    </SelectIcon>
  </SelectTrigger>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-select-trigger {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 2) calc(var(--spacing) * 3);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--input);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    outline: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger[data-size="default"] {
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 9);
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger[data-size="sm"] {
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 8);
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger[data-placeholder] {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger[aria-invalid="true"] {
    border-color: var(--destructive);
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger [data-slot="select-value"] {
    display: -webkit-box;
    overflow: hidden;
    align-items: center;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
    -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger svg {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .sigma-ui-select-trigger__icon {
    width: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectValue, type SelectValueProps } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<SelectValueProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SelectValue
    data-slot="select-value"
    v-bind="props"
  >
    <slot />
  </SelectValue>
</template>
